verses: Qasam hai saff bandhney walay (farishton) ki
Phir poori tarah dantney walon ki
Phir zikar Allah ki tilawat kerney walon ki
Yaqeenan tum sab ka mabood aik hi hai
Aasmano aur zamin aur unn kay darmiyan ki tamam cheezon aur mashriqon ka rab o hi hai
Hum ney aasman duniya ko sitaron ki zeenat say aaraasta kiya
Aur hifazat ki sirkash shetan say
Aalam bala kay farishton (ki baaton) ko sunnay kay liye woh kaan bhi nahi laga saktay, balkay)yeh her taraf say woh maaray jatay hain
Bhaganey kay liye aur unn kay liye daeemi azab hai
Magar jo koi aik aadh baat uchak ley bhagay to (foran hi) uss kay peechay dehakta hua shola lag jata hai
Unn kafiron say poocho to kay aaya unn ka peda kerna ziyadah dushwar hai ya (unn ka) jinhen hum ney (unn kay alawa) peda kiya? Hum ney (insano) ko less daar mitti say peda kiya hai
Balkay)yeh to tajjub ker raha hai aur yeh maskhara pann ker rahey hain
Aur jab unhen naseehat ki jati hai yeh nahi mantay
Aur jab kissi moajzzay ko dekhtay hain to mazaq uratay hain
Aur kehtay hain kay yeh to bilkul khullam khulla jadoo hi hai
Kiya jab hum marr jayen gay aur khak aur haddi ho jayen gay phir kiya (sach much) hum uthaye jayen gay?
Kiya hum say pehlay kay humaray baap dada bhi?
Aap jawab dijiye! kay haan haan aur tum zaleel (bhi) hun gay
Woh to sirf aik zor ki jhirki hai kay yakayak yeh dekhney lagen gay
Aur kahen gay kay haaye humari kharabi yehi jaza (saza) ka din hai
Yehi faisla ka din hai jissay tum jhutlatay rahey
Zalimon ko aur unn kay humrahiyon ko aur (jin) jin ki woh Allah kay alawa parastish kertay thay
(unn sab ko) jama kerkay unhen dozakh ki raah dikha do
Aur unhen thehra lo, (uss liye) kay unn say (zaroori) sawal kiye janey walay hain
Tumhen kiya ho gaya hai kay (uss waqt) tum aik doosray ki madad nahi kertay
Balkay)yeh woh (sab kay sab) aaj farmanbardar bann gaye
Woh aik doosray ki taraf mutawajha ho ker sawal o jawab kerney lagen gay
Kahen gay kay tum to humaray pass humari dayen taraf say aatay thay
Woh jawab den gay kay nahi balkay)yeh tum hi eman walay na thay
Aur kuch humara zor to tum per tha (hi) nahi. Balkay)yeh tum (khud) sirkash log thay
Abb to hum (sab) per humaray rab ki yeh baat sabit ho chuki kay hum (azab) chakhney walay hain
Pus hum ney tumhen gumrah kiya hum to khud bhi gumrah hi thay
So abb aaj kay din to (sab kay sab) azab mein shareek hain
Hum gunah gaaron kay sath ussi tarah kiya kertay hain
Yeh woh (log) hain kay jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah kay siwa koi mabood nahi to yeh sirkashi kertay thay
Aur kehtay thay kay kiya hum apney maboodon ko aik deewaney shaeer ki baat per chor den?
(nahi nahi) balkay)yeh (nabi) to haq (sacha deen) laye hain aur sab rasoolon ko sacha jantay hain
Yaqeenan tum dard-naak azab (ka maza) chakhney walay ho
Tumhen ussi ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kertay thay
Magar Allah Taalaa kay khalis bargazeedah banday
Unhen kay liye muqarrara rozi hai
(her tarah kay) meway, aur woh ba-izzat o ikraam hun gay
Nematon wali jannaton mein
Takhton per aik doosray kay samney (bethay) hun gay
Jari sharab kay jam ka unn per door chal raha hoga
Jo saaf shaffaf aur peenay mein lazeez hogi
Na uss say dard sir ho aur na uss kay peenay say behken
Aur unn kay pass neechi nazron, bari bari aankhon wali (hooren) hun gi
Aisi jaisay chupaye huye anday
(jannati) aik doosray ki taraf rukh kerkay poochen gay
Unn mein say aik kehney wala kahey ga kay mera aik sathi tha
Jo (mujh say) kaha kerta tha kay kiya to (qayamat kay aaney ka) yaqeen kerney walon mein say hai?
Kiya jab kay hum marr ker mitti aur haddi ho jayen gay kiya uss waqt hum jaza diye janey walay hain?
Kahey ga tum chahatay ho kay jhank ker dekh lo?
Jhaanktay hi ussay beechon baich jahannum mein (julta hua) dekhay ga
Kahey ga o Allah! qareeb tha kay to mujhay (bhi) barbaad ker dey
Agar meray rab ka ehsan na hota to mein bhi dozakh mein hazir kiye janey walon mein hota
Kiya (yeh sahih hai) kay hum marney walay hi nahi?
Ba-juz pehli aik maut kay, aur na hum azab kiye janey walay hain
Phir to (zahir baat hai kay) yeh bari kaamyabi hai
Aisi (kaamyabi) kay liye amal kerney walon ko amal kerna chahaiye
Kiya yeh mehmani achi hai ya seendh (zaqoom) ka darakht?
Jissay hum ney zalimon kay liye sakht aazmaeesh bana rakha hai
Bey shak woh darakht jahannum ki jarr mein say nikalta hai
Jiss kay khoshay shetanon kay saron jaisay hotay hain
(jahannumi) ussi darakht say khayen gay aur ussi say pet bharen gay
Phir uss per garum jultay jultay pani ki malooni hogi
Phir unn sab ka lotna jahannum ki (aag kay dher) taraf hoga
Yaqeen mano! kay unhon ney apney baap dada ko behka hua paya
Aur yeh unhi kay nishan qadam per dortay rahey
Unn say pehlay bhi boht say aglay behak chukay hain
Jin mein hum ney daraney walay (rasool) bhejay thay
Abb to dekh ley kay jinhen dhamkaya gaya tha unn ka anjam kaisa kuch hua
Siwaye Allah kay bargazeedah bandon kay
Aur humen Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ney pukara to (dekh lo) hum kaisay achay dua qabool kerney walay hain
Hum ney ussay aur uss kay ghar walon ko uss zabardast museebat say bacha liya
Aur uss ki aulad ko hum ney baqi rehney wali bana di
Aur hum ney uss ka (zikar khair) pichlon mein baqi rakha
Nooh (alaihi as-salam) per tamam jahano mein salam ho
Hum neki kerney walon ko ussi tarah badla detay hain
Woh humaray eman walay bandon mein say tha
Phir hum ney doosron ko dobo diya
Aur uss (Nooh alaihi as-salam ki) tabeydaari kerney walon mein say (hi) Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam bhi) thay
Jabkay apney rab kay pass bey aib dil laye
Unhon ney apney baap aur apni qom say kaha kay tum kiya pooj rahey ho?
Kiya tum Allah kay siwa gharay huye mabood chahatay ho?
To yeh (batlao kay) tum ney rab aalameen ko kiya samajh rakha hai?
Abb Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ney aik nigah sitaron ki taraf uthaee
Aur kaha mein to beemar hun
Uss per woh sab uss say mun moray huye wapis chalay gaye
Aap (chup chupatay) unn kay maboodon kay pass gaye aur farmaney lagay tum khatay kiyon nahi?
Tumhen kiya ho gaya kay baat tak nahi kertay ho
Phir to (poori qooat kay sath) dayen hath say unhen maarney per pal paray
Woh (butt parast) doray bhagay aap ki taraf mutawajha huye
To aap ney farmaya tum unhen poojtay ho jinhen (khud) tum tarashtay ho
Halankay tumhen aur tumhari banaee hui cheezon ko Allah hi ney peda kiya hai
Woh kehney lagay uss kay liye aik makan banao aur uss (dehakti hui) aag mein ussay daal do
Unhon ney to uss (Ibrahim alaihi as-salam) kay sath makar kerna chaha lekin hum ney unhi ko neecha ker diya
Aur uss (Ibrahim alaihi as-salam) ney kaha mein to hijrat ker kay apney perwerdigar ki taraf janey wala hun. Woh zaroor meri rehnumaee keray ga
Aey meray rab! mujhay nek bakht aulad ata farma
To hum ney ussay aik burdbaar bachay ki bisharat di

Phir jab woh (bacha) itni umar ko phoncha kay uss kay sath chalay phiray, to uss (Ibrahim alaihi as-salam) ney kaha meray piyaray bachay! mein khuwab mein apney aap ko tujhay zibah kertay huye dekh raha hun. Abb to bata kay teri kiya raye hai? Betay ney jawab diya kay abba! jo hukum hua hai ussay baja layiye inshaallah aap mujhay sabar kerney walon mein say payen gay
Gharz jab dono mutee hogaye aur uss ney (baap ney) uss ko (betay ko) peshani kay bal gira diya
To hum ney awaz di kay aey Ibrahim
Yaqeenan tu ney apney khuwab ko sacha ker dikhaya, be-shak hum neki kerney walon ko ussi tarah jaza detay hain
Dar-haqeeqat yeh khulla imtehan tha
Aur hum ney aik bara zabeeha uss kay fidya mein dey diya
Aur hum ney unn ka zikar khair pichlon mein baqi rakha
Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) per salam ho
Hum neko kaaron ko ussi tarah badla detay hain
Be-shak woh humaray eman daar bandon mein say tha
Aur hum ney uss ko Ishaq (alaihi as-salam) nabi ki bisharat di jo saleh logon mein say hoga
Aur hum ney Ibrahim o Ishaq (alaihi as-salam) per barkaten nazil farmaeen, aur unn dono ki aulad mein baazay to nek bakht hain aur baaz apney nafs per sareeh zulm kerney walay hain
Yaqeenan hum ney Musa aur Haroon (alaihi as-salam) per bara ehsan kiya
Aur unhen aur unn ki qom ko boht baray dukh dard say nijat dey di
Aur unn ki madad ki to o hi ghalib rahey
Aur hum ney unhen (wazeh aur) roshan kitab di
Aur unhen seedhay raasta per qaeem rakha
Aur hum ney unn dono kay liye peechay aaney walon mein yeh baat baqi rakhi
Kay Musa aur Haroon (alaihima as-salam) per salam ho
Bey shak hum nek logon ko ussi tarah badlay diya kertay hain
Yaqeenan yeh dono humaray momin bandon mein say thay
Bey shak ilyas (alaihi as-salam) bhi payghumbaron mein say thay
Jab kay unhon ney apni qom say farmaya kay tum Allah say dartay nahi ho?
Kiya tum ba’al (naami butt) ko pukartay ho? Aur sab say behtar khaliq ko chor detay ho?
Allah jo tumhara aur tumharay aglay tamam baap dadon ka rab hai
Lekin qom ney unhen jhutlaya, pus woh zaroor (azab mein) hazir rakhay jayen gay
Siwaye Allah Taalaa kay mukhlis bandon kay
Hum ney (ilyas alaihi as-salam) ka zikar khair pichlon mein bhi baqi rakha
Kay ilyas per salam ho
Hum neki kerney walon ko ussi tarah badla detay hain
Be-shak woh humaray eman daar bandon mein say thay
Be-shak Loot (alaihi as-salam bhi) payghumbaron mein say thay
Hum ney unhen aur unn kay ghar walon ko sab ko nijat di
Ba-juz uss burhiya kay jo peechay reh janey walon mein say reh gaee
Phir hum ney auron ko halak ker diya
Aur tum to subha honey per unn ki bastiyon kay pass say guzartay ho
Aur raat ko bhi, kiya phir bhi nahi samajhtay?
Aur bila-shuba Yunus (alaihi as-salam) nabiyon mein say thay
Jab bhaag ker phonchay bhari kashti per
Phir quraa qura-andazi hui to yeh maghloob hogaye
To phir unhen machli ney nigal liya aur woh khud apney aap ko malamat kerney lag gaye
Pus agar yeh paki biyan kerney walon mein say na hotay
To logon kay uthaye janey kay din tak uss kay pet mein hi rehtay
Pus unhen hum ney chatyal maidan mein daal diya aur woh uss waqt beemar thay
Aur unn per saya kerney wala aik bel daar darakht hum ney uga diya
Aur hum ney unhen aik lakh balkay)yeh aur ziyadah aadmiyon ki taraf bheja
Pus woh eman laye, aur hum ney unhen aik zamaney tak aish aish-o-ishrat di
Unn say daryaft kijiye! kay kiya aap kay rab ki to betiyan hain aur unn kay betay hain?
Ya yeh uss waqt mojood thay jabkay hum ney farishton ko moanniss peda kiya
Aagah raho! kay yeh log sirf apni iftra perdaazi say keh rahey hain
Kay Allah Taalaa ki aulad hai. Yaqeenan yeh mehaz jhootay hain
Kiya Allah Taalaa ney apney liye betiyon ko beton per tarjeeh di
Tumhen kiya ho gaya hai kaisay hukum lagatay phirtay ho?
Kiya tum uss qadar bhi nahi samajhtay?
Ya tumharay pass uss ki koi saaf daleel hai
To jao agar sachay ho to apni hi kitab ley aao
Aur unn logon ney to Allah kay aur jinnat kay darmiyan bhi qarabat daari thehraee hai, aur halankay khud jinnat ko maloom hai kay woh (uss aqeedah kay log azab kay samney) paish kiye jayen gay
Jo kuch yeh (Allah kay baray mein) biyan ker rahey hain uss say Allah Taalaa bilkul pak hai
Siwaye! Allah kay mukhlis bandon kay
Yaqeen mano kay tum sab aur tumharay maboodaan (baatil)
Kissi aik ko bhi behka nahi saktay
Ba-juz uss kay jo jahannumi hi hai
(farishton ka qol hai kay) hum mein say to her aik ki jagah muqarrar hai
Aur hum to (bandagi elahi mein) saff basta kharay hain
Aur uss ki tasbeeh biyan ker rahey hain
Kuffaar to kaha kertay thay
Kay agar humaray samney aglay logon ka zikar hota
To hum bhi Allah kay cheedah banday bann jatay
Lekin phir uss Quran kay sath kufur ker gaye, pus abb unqareeb jaan len gay
Aur albatta humara wada pehlay hi apney rasoolon kay liye sadir ho chuka hai
Kay yaqeenan woh hi madad kiye jayen gay
Aur humara hi lashkar ghalib (aur bartar) rahey ga
Abb aap kuch dino tak unn say mun pher lijiye
Aur unhen dekhtay rahiye, aur yeh bhi aagay chal ker dekh len gay
Kiya yeh humaray azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain?
Suno! jab humara azab unn kay maidan mein utar aaye ga uss waqt unn ki jin ko muta-nabbay ker diya gaya tha bari buri subha hogi
Aap kuch waqt tak unn ka khayal chor dijiye
Aur dekhtay rahiyey yeh bhi abhi abhi dekh len gay
Pak hai aap ka rab jo boht bari izzat wala hai her uss cheez say (jo mushrik) biyan kertay hain
Payghumbaron per salam hai
Aur sab tarah ki tareef Allah kay liye hai jo saray jahaan ka rab hai
